zeros, then padded to at least two digits. Whole amounts and short fractions get two decimals (`1.50`, `2.00`, `0.25`), and longer fractions keep every significant digit so `parseNear(formatNear(x)) === x` holds. I didn't touch `parseNear`.

I also checked edge cases beyond the visible tests: `0` → `0.00`, 1 yocto → `0.000000000000000000000001`, `0.123` → `0.123`, and inputs at the `10^30` limit (`1000000.00`) all round-trip exactly.
